title: Real Analysis
description: Real Analysis turns calculus into a rigorous proof-based theory of limits, continuity, differentiation, integration, and convergence. It is central for advanced mathematics and supports mathematically rigorous economics.

topics.title: Real Numbers and Completeness
topics.description: This section develops real numbers and completeness through the concrete vocabulary, procedures, examples, and checks students need in Real Analysis.

children.title: Specific Terms and Concepts
children.description: Learn the named vocabulary that makes real numbers and completeness precise rather than just intuitive.

children.title: Procedures, Calculations, or Analytic Moves
children.description: Practice the concrete moves students should be able to perform when working with real numbers and completeness.

children.title: Apply ordered field in a worked example
Compare least upper bound with Archimedean property
Common Cases, Pitfalls, and Checks
children.description: Use these details to recognize where real numbers and completeness succeeds, where it can mislead, and what to check before trusting a result.

children.title: Explain how ordered field changes the interpretation
